examples.arabic: هي اشترت قميص لونه زهري للرحلة الطويلة
examples.english: She bought a pink shirt for the long trip
examples.transliteration: Hiya ishtarat qamis lawnuhu zahri lil rihla al tawila

examples.english: The family wants a trip this week.
The children want a big and fun trip.
examples.transliteration: Al-atfal yuriduna rihlatan kabiratan wa mumti'atan

examples.arabic: فرح الأطفال كثيرًا بتحديد موعد الرحلة إلى الشاطئ الجميل
examples.english: The children were very happy with setting the trip's time to the beautiful beach
examples.transliteration: Fariha al-atfal kathiran bi-tahdid maw'id al-rihlah ila ash-shati' al-jameel

examples.english: The father wants a quiet trip.

examples.arabic: اختيار مكان الرحلة كان قرارا صعبا بعض الشيء
examples.english: Choosing the trip's place was a somewhat difficult decision.
examples.transliteration: Ikhtiyar makan ar-rihlah kana qararan sa'ban ba'd ash-shay'.
